name: Age-Gated Eligibility (AGE)
definition: An age-gated densification-eligibility rule that defers a new primitive’s first split-or-clone decision until it has matured, damping the densification cascade and bounding the primitive budget.
summary: Age-Gated Eligibility prevents uncontrolled primitive growth by deferring split or clone operations until a Gaussian survives a fixed maturity window, bounding the final primitive budget.
